title: Rubric - Redundancy
evidence: No significant redundancy between criteria. Each criterion targets a distinct verification point: criteria 6 vs 7 test different telemetry line types (MOTION_SAMPLE vs ACTION_TRANSITION). Criteria 16-23 each target a different visual element (3D panel, tokens, blast ring, HUD, grid, collection strip, title, row zones). Criteria 24 vs 27 test different aspects of the action counter (monotonic values in MOTION_SAMPLE vs sequential counting in ACTION_TRANSITION). Criteria 8 vs 10 test different timing properties (span duration vs sampling interval). There is appropriate complementary overlap (e.g., criteria 6 tests format while criteria 28 tests value consistency within the same lines), but this is not redundancy — they verify different properties.
